rename_main: The main chat has no title to change
main_changed: The main chat has already changed. Refresh and try again.
main_busy: The main chat is answering or compacting. Start a new one once it stops.
guest_node_too_old: The personad on this computer is too old for guest conversations; update it and try again.
work_machine: Assistant conversations cannot run on a work computer. Choose a personal computer.
launcher_not_main_chat: {launcher} can start Agents on {machine} but can’t run assistant chats, so this message wasn’t sent. Pick another launcher in the menu and send again.
launcher_other_kind: {launcher} runs {launcher_agent}, but this conversation runs on {conversation_agent} and can't change it, so this message wasn't sent. Pick a {conversation_agent} launcher, or start a new conversation on {launcher}.
launcher_no_substitute: {launcher} isn’t on {machine} any more, and no other launcher of the same kind there can run assistant chats, so this message wasn’t sent. Choose one in Model configuration › Main chat.
launcher_swapped: {launcher} can’t run assistant chats on {machine}, so this runs on {to}
launcher_swapped_model: {launcher} can’t run assistant chats on {machine}, so this runs on {to} with its default model ({model} isn’t in its list)
